 Evening features special demonstrations plus a limited-edition scarf available for purchase; Kickoff is 6:30pm PT
 Strengthend by back-to-back victories, the Portland Timbers sit only three points out of a postseason spot with two regular-season games left to play. Next up: This Sunday, the Timbers host Houston Dynamo FC at Providence Park on Native American Heritage Night.
 Kickoff is 6:30pm PT. 
 Along with special demonstrations from members of the Confederated Tribes of Grand Ronde, a limited-edition Native American Heritage Night scarf will be available for purchase at PTFC Authentic locations at Providence Park. Get all the details on the special night. 
 How To Watch & Listen 
 Watch the Timbers all season long on Apple TV. Sunday's match will also be aired nationally on FS1.
Watch Timbers on Apple TV 
 Timbers fans can watch  the entire 2026 season live on Apple TV including Leagues Cup and the MLS Cup Playoffs – no blackouts - with an Apple TV subscription. All matches and exclusive MLS programming are included with an Apple TV subscription at no additional cost.
 How to Watch 
 Listen live on 105.1 The Fan with Fletcher Johnson, Aaron Heinzen and Adam Susman, while a Spanish-language broadcast is available on La GranD 1150 AM/93.5 FM.
 Storylines 
 The Matchup 
 Apple TV's Jake Zivin explains the high stakes, for both teams, in Sunday's showdown.
 Cifuentes: "It's going to be a tough challenge" 
 Head coach Martí Cifuentes spoke about Kamal Miller's red card as well as the challenges of Houston's play style and how he and the team are carrying the energy of back-to-back wins forward.
